verdict.rationale: Codex CLI supports resuming and searching past local chat sessions ('codex resume'), and the desktop app auto-surfaces prior project threads, giving some session recall, but there's no evidence of automatic memory building (e.g., persistent facts/context distilled and reused without user action) — recall is manual (search/resume) rather than automatic across sessions. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic memory synthesis/storage, cross-session knowledge persistence without manual resume, and independent confirmation of memory accuracy or usefulness.
